meta_title: Notts Auto Keys | Car Locksmith Nottingham
meta_description: Notts Auto Keys is your trusted car locksmith in Nottingham. Fast emergency response, key replacement, and lock repairs. Call now for same-day help.
hero_subhead: Locked out of your car in Nottingham? We arrive within 45 minutes, any time of day or night.
services_heading: Complete Car Locksmith Services Across Nottingham
services_subhead: From emergency lockouts to key programming, we handle every car lock problem quickly and affordably.

services.title: Emergency Car Unlocking
services.desc: Locked yourself out? We arrive within 45 minutes and open your car safely, with no damage to windows or locks. Available 24/7 across Nottingham.

services.title: Car Key Replacement
services.desc: Lost your keys or need a spare? We cut and programme new car keys for most makes and models on the spot, usually within the hour.

services.title: Key Fob Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Dead or broken key fob? We repair faulty remotes or supply and programme brand-new fobs to get you back on the road fast.

services.title: Broken Key Extraction
services.desc: Key snapped in your lock? We safely remove the broken piece without damaging your car, then supply a replacement key.

services.title: Lock Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Damaged door locks or ignition cylinder? We repair or replace faulty locks and test them to ensure smooth operation.

services.title: Transponder & Smart Key Programming
services.desc: Modern cars need specialist programming. We programme transponder keys, proximity fobs, and smart keys to sync with your vehicle.

about_pullquote: I started this business to offer fair prices and honest service when people are most stressed.
about_para_1: Notts Auto Keys was founded over 12 years ago in Bilborough, Nottingham. We specialised in automotive locks from day one, building our reputation by responding quickly to emergencies and treating every locked car — and every customer — with care. Today, we've unlocked over 500 cars every year and remain one of Nottingham's most trusted local locksmiths.
about_para_2: Customers return to us because we're honest about costs, we arrive when we say we will, and we've never damaged a car. We're not the cheapest, but we're reliable, and our regular clients know they can call us at 2am and we'll be there. That's the difference between a cowboy and a craftsman — and we're proud to be the latter.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Drivers Say About Us

reviews.text: Locked my keys in the car on the way to work. Called Notts Auto Keys at 7:30am and they were at my office in Lace Market within 40 minutes. Professional, friendly, and didn't break the bank. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Snapped my car key in half on a Saturday evening. Thought I was stuck, but the lads got out to Beeston within an hour, removed the broken bit, and had a new key cut and coded the same night. Saved my weekend. Proper job.
reviews.author: Michelle K.

reviews.text: Third time I've used Notts Auto Keys now. They're reliable, honest, and fair on price. My key fob died and they reprogrammed it for £60. Other places wanted nearly double. Will keep using them.
reviews.author: Paul R.
